tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos lhan skyes rnam bzhi sgrub cing nyams su blang ba ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa brgyud nas bshad pa'i gnas gang yang rung bar lhan skyes bzhi ga'am gang rung nyams su blang bya'i bris sku bshams pa'i mdun tu dkar gtor pad+mas bskor ba'i mdun tu mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sogs dang*/ rdor dril nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa 'du bya/ stan bde bar 'dug nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ nang mchod oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i ā las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dbus dang phyogs bzhir hūm̐ am̐ kham̐ am̐ trām̐ dang*/ bām̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron me lngar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa rlung gis bskyod/ me sbar zhing bskol bas sa bon dang bcas pa'i rdzas rnams zhu ba nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i kha dog can/ de'i rlangs pa las grub pa'i dngul chu'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'og tu lta ba/ de nyid kyang zhu nas bcud dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i steng du a ā nas/ ha k+ṣaḥyongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ steng nas steng du brtsegs te gnas pa las dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spros/ sems can gyi don byas nas snyoms par zhugs pas yi ge gsum la thim/ yi ge gsum yang dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces byin gyis brlabs shing myang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/

pad kor rdor thal kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tson+ma da a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhu dza tha/ bi wa tha/ dzigh+rā tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar+t+ta ya/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dhā ya/ sahā yi ka bha ban+tuhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum dang*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus= /gnod sbyin= /srin po'i= /'byung po'i= /yi dwags= /sha za'i= /smyo byed= /rjed byed= /mkha' 'gro'i= /ma mo'i= /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin stsol// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces gtor ma dbul/ mchod pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las thod pa'i snod du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod sprin lta bu dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dgyes pa bskyed nus par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin tu/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/

ghan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shab+da/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ bdag dus deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// gsum dang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros sa rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa phyogs kyi mdog can du gyur pa'i 'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang*/ rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i drwa ba dang*/ gur gyi nang du bla re/ phyi rol rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar bas bar med du khyab par gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūm̐ pam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañdza ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sha ra dzā la tram̐ bam̐ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor ba'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje 'chang zhabs pad la 'dud// ces bstod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab sgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ces lan gsum gyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du rdo rje'i gur 'jig dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba me ri dang bcas pa gsal ba'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ ces pa ni lhan skyes bzhi ga la rigs 'gres pa bya zhing*/ lhan skyes bzhi ga phyogs gcig tu byed na tshad med bzhi yan chad thun mong du byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā man chad lha so sor bya'o// dang po gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang nyid skad cig

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud las/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// spro dang bsdu pa byed pa'o// ye shes skad cig gis rdzogs pa// rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed pa ni rags pa'i rdzogs rim pa zab mo bskyed pa'i man ngag ces rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng du gsungs pa ste ches shin tu zab khyad che'o// mchan/ gis bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhe sdang rdo rje mthing nag zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la 'khyud pa/ yab kyi zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ do shal/ ska rags/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ mtshan dpes spras pa 'od kyi phreng ba 'phro zhing 'bar bar gyur/ ces dang*/ gnyis pa bde mchog lhan skyes dril bu lugs ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang*/ g.yon brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la yid bzhin nor bu dang zla phyed sna tshogs rdo rje brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo phreng dar dpyang 'chang ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi phreng ba can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/

ces dang*/ gsum par dgyes rdor lhan skyes shān+ti pa'i lugs ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad nyi ro'i gdan la rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po khros pa'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar zhing 'khrugs pa/ g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu dang g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa gnyis bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngo bsangs/ gri thod 'dzin cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ yab yum ye shes kyi me 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ ces dang*/ bzhi pa dus 'khor lhan skyes rā hu la shrī bha dra'i lugs ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan gyi gdan la rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag gnyis kyi mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang gu/ sor mo rnams kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po can rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas dmar po brkyangs pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying ga mnan cing*/ g.yon dkar ba bskums pas drag po dkar po mnan pa/ lha mo dga' ma dang u ma gdong dman pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i cod pan yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang zla phyed sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha dang rdo rje'i rgyan can/ stag spags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ sku stod la glang chen gyi ko rlon 'chang ba/

thal chen gyis byugs pa/ dar dpyangs dang mchod phyir thogs kyis spras pa'i pang du sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba gri thod 'dzin cing*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga 'chang zhing gcer mo skra phyed rgyab tu grol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas yab la sbyor ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ yab yum dri ma med pa'i 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro bar gyur/ ces so// de nas lhan skyes bzhi po gang bsgoms kyang gsal snang thon nas lha yab yum gyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ 'bar ba'i rgyu smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang dbang gi lha rnams thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ lag gnyis 'dod yon rnam lnga 'dod kor dang 'khyud rgyas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhā sarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor du dag la bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag go /zhes nga rgyal gzung*/ ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas lha thams cad bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur te chu lhag ma las/

gsang 'dus kyi skabs su yab yum gnyis ka la rdo rje 'chang gis dbu brgyan/ ces so// bde mchog gi skabs su bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ ces dang*/ dgyes rdor gyi skabs yab yum gnyis la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ces dang*/ dus 'khor gyi skabs yab yum gnyis la rgyal ba lnga sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan/ ces dang*/ thun mong du dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas phyi mchod ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin pa nam mkha'i khams kun nas gang bas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod ni/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3taṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang lha yab yum gang yin gyi sngags mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba dharma pā la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod thigs gtor 'bul/ gsang mchod ni/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru āḥs mtshan pa bde ba 'bab pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba/ de nas snying ga'i bar mchog dga'/ de nas lte ba'i bar khyad dga'/ de nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor son pas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po nyams su myangs par gyur/ 'khyud rgya byas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/

brjod/ de kho na'i mchod pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i gnas goms pas// lha yi snying po sgom byed pa// de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod// sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o// zhes gnas lugs bsgom/ bstod pa ni rdo dril dang bcas pas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// ces bstod la bskyed rim la mnyam par bzhag slar rdzogs rim ni/ bdag nyid he ru kar gnas pa'i sku'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su haṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab kyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir g.yas skor du mām̐ lām̐ pām̐ tām̐ ām̐ rnams dkar sngo ser ljang dmar/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su sum̐ dkar po/ phyogs bzhir mdun nas g.yas skor du hūm̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐ rnams sngo ser dmar ljang*/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su ā dmar po gsal ba rlung gi sbyor bas ā las gtum mo'i me sbar bas yi ge bcu po bsregs shing haṃ las dkar cha'i rgyun babs pas yi ge bcu slar gsos shing dkar dmar 'dres bas rtsa 'khor thams cad gang zhing yi ge rnams la dri ma med pa'i 'od 'phro bas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myangs par gyur/

ces yun ring du bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas skyo na/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng thon pa dhū tī'i nang brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs pa sku'i dbyibs brgyud yum gyi zhal nas thon te rang gi zhal du zhugs shing 'khor bar gyur par dmigs nas/ gsang 'dus yab la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛk hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ yum la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā twī shwa rī hūm̐/ zhes sogs/ bde mchog yab la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ yum la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so// dgyes rdor yab la/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ yum la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sogs/ dus 'khor yab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho ham̐k+ṣamalawaraya hūm̐ phaṭa// ces dang*/ yum la/ oṃ āḥbi shwa ma tṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so// de ltar lhan skyes bzhi po gang yin yang yab kyi bsnyen pa'i grangs ci tsam bzlas pa'i bcu cha tsam yum la yang bzla dgos so// thun mthar bsdu rim ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rten gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu nas yum la thim/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus nas nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur pa'i ngang du bzhag slar yang rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis dpa' rkyang gi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes thun mtshams kyi spyod lam dge ba'i bya ba gang dgos la 'jug go /lhan skyes bzhi ga lhan cig tu byed na nang mchod byin rlabs nas tshad med bzhi yan thun mong du bya zhing*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur gyi bar dang*/ spyan 'dren nas thun mtshams su bsdu rim gyi bar lhan skyes re re'i las de rnams re re sbyar dgos shing*/

rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs sngags rnams rang rang skabs thob byed dgos so// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ thog mar 'jig rten las 'das pa dkyil 'khor pa la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor mar bdud rtsi bran la nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs rjes/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ phaiṃ gtor mgron gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang ro gcig par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛk badz+ra dhā trī shwa rī i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa ma ma sarba sid+dhi pha la ku ru swā hā/ bdun gyis 'bul/ mchod cing bstod nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar 'dis mtshon nas lhan skyes gzhan gsum la'ang gtor mgron che ge mo'i dkyil 'khor zhes dang i maṃ gyi gong du lhan skyes gang yin pa yab yum gyi sngags sbyar bas 'grub bo// brjod/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor mar bdud rtsi bran pa nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ phaiṃ dbang po la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbarjod/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ gong ltar mchod nas/ phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// nas/ kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar brjod/

'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtsang sar dor la/ 'jig rten 'das pa thun mong du yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs te/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs/ ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bsrung*/ lhan skyes bzhi ga phyogs gcig tu byed na 'das gtor yang thun mong du phyogs gcig la byin rlabs byas rjes mngon rtogs kyi go rim ltar lha yab yum rnams rim gyis sngags re re'i mjug tu i maṃ sogs btags pa bdun bdun gyis phul rjes thun mong du mchod cing 'dud nyi shus bstod la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms sogs bzhi ga la thun mong du byas pas 'grub bo// bsngo ba dang smon lam bya/ kha zas kyi tshe kha zas nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying gar ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa'i dbus su lhan skyes bzhi ga'am re re sogs gang byed gsal btab la/ lag g.yas blugs gzar dang*/ lce hūm̐ dang rdo rje las byung ba'i dgang gzar du bsams la bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor phul bas lha rnams tshim par gyur/ khrus kyi tshe bum dbang gi cho ga ltar bya/ nyal ba'i tshe snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus la bsam gtan gnyid kyi man ngag ltar bya/ ldang ba'i tshe rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis zhu ba'i glus bskul nas sad de 'gro don du langs par bsam/ gzhan yang gtso bor bskyed rdzogs dang bzlas pas dus 'da' bar bya zhing*/ thun mtshams su dge ba'i bya ba kha ton dang sāts+tsha gdab ba sogs bsags sbyang la 'bad cing bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa'i thun mtshams la sogs pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyis kun nas bslang bar bya ba ni gnad dam pa'o// zhes pa'ang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mngon par rtogs pa spros pa cher gsungs pa de rnams deng sang snyigs ma lnga bdor tshe thung bas long med pa la bsam zhing*/

khyad par blo dman rnams kyi 'jug pa bde zhing rang nyid kyang nyams su blang ba'i phyir 'bri khung pa skyu ra'i rigs las sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas rang lo so bdun gyi steng lcags lug zla ba dgu pa'i dmar po'i tshes bcu la gdan sa chen po 'bri khung du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa mnga' ris lha mo dkon mchog lhun grub bo// sid+dhi rastu// ༈ /bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba bzhugs so// na mo mū la gu ru ga ya dha rā ya/ 'dir byin rlabs nus pa'i drod tshad dang ldan pa'i bla mas dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma la lhan skyes bzhi'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi cho ga ltar bskur ba ni/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu sogs mkha' 'gro rgyu ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe yid dang mthun pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i gnas dur khrod la sogs par bris sku bkram zhing*/ bdud rtsi dang dris byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar nyi gdan la lha'i mdog mthun gyi phyag mtshan gyi lte bar sa bon gyis mtshan pa bris pa'i nye logs su rin po che'i bum pa gnyis kha rgyan mgul chings dang ldan zhing lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa bshams shing mtha' mchod pas bskor/ slob dpon gyi nye logs su rdo dril nang mchod ḍa ma ru la sogs pa'i mkho ba'i yo byad rnams dang 'jig 'das kyi gtor ma tshogs rdzas sogs sta gon byas la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor nang mchod byin rlabs nas thun bsdus nas dpa' gcig tu ldang ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ mdun bskyed ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor shū n+ya tās bsang nas/ gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang nyid skad cig gis zhes pa dor/ de ltar lha gang yin de nyid bskyed nas 'bar ba'i rgyas/ phaiṃ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i zhes pa nas gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar byas rjes/

lha yab yum gyi spyi bor zla ba la zhes pa nas sngon pos mtshan par gyur gyi bar dang*/ de nas ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lhas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams yab yum la thim par gyur/ ces dang*/ mchod pa sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i mchod pa rnams dang bstod pa sogs sgrub thabs ltar byas rjes lha yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las rang 'dra'i dkyil 'khor ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rang 'dra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshul 'dus sa bon sngags phreng la thim zhing 'od 'bar bar gyur par dmigs nas sngags brgya stong gang thub bzla/ bum bskyed ni/ gtso bum gyi steng du dung chos dri chus bkang ba'i khar rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bkod/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos gang zhing dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa gnyis las/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad nyi sogs nas/ gyur gyi bar mdun bskyed ltar lha gang yin yab yum bskyed/ las bum gyi nang du sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po bgegs mthar byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen tu brdzes pa/ g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ brkyang bskum gyis bsgyings shing khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ khro rngams 'jigs par byed pa 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ de nas 'bar ba'i rgyas/ phaiṃ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i nas/ las bum gyi lha la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/

dbang gi lha rnams lha so so la thim par gyur gyi bar mdun bskyed ltar dang*/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas phyi nang gsang ba de kho nas mchod/ rnam rgyal gyi lha yab yum la 'dud nyi shu dang*/ las bum la/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng spros pas gzungs thag la brgyud de song ba bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul zhing rnam rgyal gyi lha yab yum rjes su chags pa'i snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams su byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang zhing*/ las bum gyi lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par dmigs nas lha gang yin gyi sngags dang mthar gzungs thag rdo rje las bum gyi khar spos la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛt yang ci nus bzla/ mthar mchod cing*/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod la/ lha rnams rjes su chags pa chen pos zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ ces dung gi chu rnam rgyal du blugs/ las bum gyi lhas 'dir dbang ngam rab gnas sam sbyin sreg sogs skabs don gang yin gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig ces gsol/ 'das pa'i gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar la khyad par ni lhan skyes re re ma gtogs dbang gi skabs lha bzhi ga la cho ga gcig gis mi 'grub pas lha gang yin gyi sngags kyis dbul ba sogs sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ de rjes 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma yang sgrub thabs ltar dbul zhing*/ ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/

bdag nyid 'jug pa ni las bum gyis khrus bya ba nas gtang rag gi bar slob mar dbang bskur ltar la/ khyad par ni/ dkyil 'khor pas slob dpon dang de las 'dra ba spros pas las kyi rdo rje mdzad par bsam/ slob ma zhes pa'i mal du rang nyid ces 'don pa spos shing slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis byas pas 'grub bo// de nas slob ma gzhug pa ni/ slob ma rnams las thams cad pas khrus byas/ gral la 'god/ me tog bkram nas maṇ+ḍal phul la thal mo sbyar nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab cing*/ thun mong du sems bskyed cing rgyun bshags ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar gsum bya/ rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa gzung ba ni/ slob mas de 'dzin gyi bsam pa dang bcas pas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa yi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// de kho na nyid gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin tu dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad bde bar ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// gsum gyis sdom pa gzung*/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dhā wā ra ma ṇā ya hūm̐ gis mig dar g.yogs/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ khyad par sngags su sems bskyed pa ni/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par bsams la/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes sems bskyed/ de nyid brtan pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa slob ma'i snying gar bzhag nas/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dh+ya badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes brjod/ oṃ na mā te hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gsum gyis phyag bya/ dam chu sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ zhes sbyin/ slob ma'i mgo'am lag tu rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/

zhes brjod cing bsgrag ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis stong pa nyid kyi rjes su āḥlas byung ba'i gsung rdo rje snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhengs pa'i snying gar lam̐ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgo bor wam̐ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su zla ba la ha dkar po/ mgrin par yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan g.yo ba gnyis kyis mtshan par zla ba la āḥdamar po/ rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis sbar ba'i ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum yi ge ras mtshan pa 'od zer 'phro ba la gnas pa'i dzhaiḥdamar pos slob ma 'degs bzhin pa/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis thugs gsung sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs la de rnams kyi rang bzhin hūm̐ ha āḥ'i yi ge rnams la bstim zhing rkang pa'i bu ga nas dzhaiḥ'i 'od zer gyi tshogs zhugs pa dang hūm̐ la sogs pa'i 'od kyis lus mtha' dag kun nas gang bar gyur par bsams shing*/ ā be sha ya stam+bha ya ra ra ra ra tsa lā ya tsa lā ya hūm̐ ha āḥdzhaiḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad 'don zhing bsam gtan la gzhol bas dril bu gsil zhing*/ bud med kyi 'dom dkris zla mtshan gyis sbags pa byi la'i brun yi dwags kyi kha nas byung ba'i gu gul sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams thod phor du ro sol gyi me la bsregs nas bdug go /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ slob mas me tog dor zhing*/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ pra tīts+tsha ku su māñdza li nā tha ho/

zhes dor/ me tog gang du bab pa'i mchog dman bar mar lung bstan/ slar me tog slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mgor bcings la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇā s+t+waṃ -i maṃ satwa ma hā bā la/ zhes brjod/ mig dbye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*// khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzod// oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ zhes mig dar bsal/ bcom ldan 'das che ge mo'i dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mthong bar bsam/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug pa slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs pa sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa bcom ldan 'das che ge mo lhan skyes mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab pa'i pad+ma nas phyung mdun du dbang stegs la 'khod par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la'ang stsal du gsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ dbang lha bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes lnga'i chus gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis slob ma'i steng phyogs su gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa 'dzin zhing me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pa la/ slob mas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig

/ces gsol ba btab pa la dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pas// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum 'byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyi sbyin par bya// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ud ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra twa s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes bskur/ 'dir rigs dbang gzhan bzhi'i tshab tu bum pa nyid mgo bo'i phyogs bzhi dang dbus rnams su bzhag nas bum chu sbyin no// de dag gis slob ma'i nyon mongs pa lnga sbyangs/ phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bor byas shing*/ rgyal ba lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag slar mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha dang slob dpon la bdag po'i don du/ slob mas/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don byed nus 'gyur// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter kye bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa'i tshe dbang lhas rdo dril bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsams shing*/ slob dpon gyis slob mar rdo dril gtad la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes g.yas dang*/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu oṃ badz+ra ghāṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes g.yon tu gtad/ slob mas 'khyud rgya byas la/ slob dpon gyis/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// ces dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes dbang bskur/ de'i tshe slob mas bde ba chen po phun sum tshogs pa skyes/ chu lhag ma las slob ma lhar gsal ba'i dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ltag g.yas su rin 'byung*/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ltag g.yon tu don grub/ spyi bor rnam snang*/

bde dgyes gsang gsum la longs sku'i cha lugs can rang 'dra'i yum dang sbyor ba/ dus 'khor la sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor slob ma la bstim/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ sngags gtad pa ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las/ sngags phreng mar me gnyis chad kyi tshul du zhal nas thon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i rna ba g.yas pa nas zhugs/ snying gar 'khor bar bsams la slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ lha'i sngags rnams lan gsum bzla bar bya'o// de ltar dbang bskur bas khyod kyis phyi mtshan bcas kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ thun mong ba lus kyis gtsor bsags pa'i las gsum gyi dri ma sngar bsags pa sbyangs zhing phyi ma sdom/ thun mong ma yin pa lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma 'khrud/ sprul sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mngon tu gyur pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ slob mas/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med bya ba thob// de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// mgon pos rjes su gzung bar mdzod// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcing*/ bla ma lhan skyes gang yin yab dang*/ rig ma yum dang*/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs rnams sgrub thabs ltar gsal gdab/ snyoms 'jug gis rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum snyoms 'jug mdzad pa bkug bdag gi zhal du bcug pa chags pa chen pos zhu ba dhū tī nas brgyud/ mkha' gsang du babs pa rang gi byang sems dang 'dres pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhu ba'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bdud rtsi mkha' gsang du babs pa/ slob ma rab kyis mkha' gsang nas lces blang*/

'bring la slob dpon gyis mtheb srin gyis blangs pa slob ma'i lcer bzhag tha ma la thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang bsres pa khar sbyin dgos la/ 'di'i rab 'bring ni slob ma rtog pa 'joms pa rab sogs so// de'i tshe bla mas/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgyi// zhes brjod cing sbyin/ slob mas myang zhing a ho ma hā su khaṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ mig dar bsal/ de ltar dbang bskur bas khyod kyis gsang ba bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ thun mong ba ngag gi las bzhi'i dri ma sngar bsags pa sbyangs zhing phyi ma sdom/ thun mong ma yin pa las rlung gi dri ma 'khrud/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog lam bdag byin rlabs kyi rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes rtogs pa brjod/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ sher dbang gi don tu maṇ+ḍal dbul/ slob mas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gdong bcings la/ slob dpon gyis rig ma mtshan ldan gyi lag g.yon pa nas bzung ba slob ma'i g.yas su gtad la/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu'i nang du chud par blta// gar du skyes gyur ye shes kyi// ye shes de ni ngo bor dmigs// zhes gtad cing*/ slob ma lhan skyes gang yin yab dang*/

rig ma yum/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs rnams sgrub thabs ltar byas rjes/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes snyoms 'jug bsrub pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas byang sems smin mtshams nas mgrin par babs pa dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar khyad par gyi dga' ba/ nor bur lhan skyes dang*/ de'i tshe slob ma lhar gsal ba'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum rnams bkug pa kha nas zhugs pas lus byin gyis brlabs shing bla mas kyang rgyal ba yab yum spyan drangs pa rnams slob ma yab yum gyi lus la bcug pa dang ro gcig par gyur par bsam/ de'i tshe slob mas nus pa ji lta bar bzung la ma zin na dal bus btang la chu skyes nas lces blangs te de kho na nyid kyi bsam pas dam tshig gi ngo bo byang sems btung bar bya'o// de nas mig dar bsal/ de ltar dbang bskur bas khyod kyis kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thun mong ba yid kyi las gsum gyi dri ma sngar bsags pa sbyangs zhing phyi ma sdom/ thun mong ma yin pa gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rags pa'i dri ma 'khyud/ chos kyi sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog lam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob mas/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ mig dar g.yogs sam mi g.yogs gang bde bya/ bla mas/ shes rab ye shes de nyid rgyur gyur pa'i byang chub sems bsgoms pas rab tu 'phel bzhin pa/ sgrib pa med pa nyid du gyur pa'i de kho na nyid chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid kyi rang bzhin/

yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid rdo rje chen po'i rang bzhin can de nyid dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes yin la/ de yang dbang gsum pas ngo sprad pa'i dpe'i lhan skyes shes rab ye shes de nyid don gyi lhan skyes kyi 'bras bu'i rgyu lta bu yin la/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de ni bsgom pa ste goms par byas pas gong nas gong du rab tu 'phel bzhin pa/ las sgrib thams cad zag pa med pa nyid du gyur ba'i de kho na nyid chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal chos kyi sku dang*/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bdag nyid dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin can gang yin pa de ni dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin pas rtogs par byos shig ces brjod/ spro na dpe'i sgo nas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral thar sbyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes dang*/ de'i don rgyas par brjod/ mig dar bsal/ de ltar dbang bskur bas khyod kyi don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ thun mong ba sgo gsum ga'i dri ma phra mo bag chags dang bcas pa sngar bsags pa sbyangs zhing phyi ma sdom/ thun mong ma yin pa ye shes kyi dri ma gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog phra mo rnams 'khrud/ ngo bo nyid sku bde ba chen po'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog lam phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje gsum ro mnyam pa'i ye shes rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ dam tshig bsrung ba'i sems kyis/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul lo// tshogs kyi mchod pa bya bar spro na/

ma da na la sogs pa shes rab kyi rdzas rnams g.yon dang*/ sha zan la sogs pa'i thabs kyi rdzas rnams g.yas dang*/ khur ba sogs g.yos sbyar gyi rdzas rnams dbus su bzhag par nang mchod bran nas/ sgrub thabs kyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ sha zan sogs tshogs rdzas rnams kyi phud nas cung zad re bris sku sogs kyi drung du phul/ ma da na sogs sbran la/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// dgyes pa mchog gi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yi dam

so sor byed na yi dam gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs phral la bya'o// lhan skyes rnam bzhi la// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral la// bstan srung rgya mtshos bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// oṃ gu ru de wā ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes dbul/ las kyi rdo rjes lag g.yas ma da na'i snod thogs/ g.yon ba dan gsum pa'i rgya bstan la/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom bya mi rung*// bram ze khyi phag gdol par bcas// lhan cig mnyam pa'i dbyings su rol// ces slob dpon la drangs shing*/ slob dpon gyis rnam lnga 'dod kor gyis/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de bzhin nyid la bdag 'dud do// zhes blang*/ de nas mched lcam rnams la drang zhing bag dang ldan pas longs spyod/ dam tshig gcig pa kho na'i lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya kha'i thad du brkyangs pa'i dbus nas su ra'i kha phru btab la/ a kā ro bdun dang*/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa pa ti sarba bhū ta bhak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes gtsang sar dor/ bum mdun gyi lha la mchod cing bstod nas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs gyur pas// legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa// mgon pos de kun bzod par mdzod// ces dang*/ he ru ka'i yig brgyas bskang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥs mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/

dam tshig pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi sogs kyis shis pa brjod cing*/ smon lam gyis rgyas gdab/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// dkyil chog 'di kho bos bgyis pa'i bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi sgrub thabs kyi dbang la yang sbyar bar rung ngo*// zhes pa'ang gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga spros pa cher gsungs pa rnams deng sang gi rdo rje slob dpon tu rlom pa rnams kyi blo mtshor ma spobs pas gzu lum dang ras gcod kho nar 'dug pas/ 'dir slob dman gyi slob dpon dang slob ma rnams 'jug pa bde bar snying po rnams bsdus nas byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba'i cho ga 'di yang 'bri khung pa gsang ba sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes lcags lug zla ba bcu pa'i dkar cha'i rdzogs pa dang po la dpal 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen por sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs pa ste yi ge pa ni 'bangs kyi tha shal mnga' ris lha mo dkon mchog lhun grub bo// sarba dā maṅga laṃ/ shu bham// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
